messages:
maria: Quick micro-sprint  we need a distinct copy pass for three landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) that ties to the webinar cohort funnel. Focus: scannable hero, one micro-benchmark tile, clear CTA routing, and a short lead-scoring hint for SDRs.
ashley: Draft hero idea: 'One API. Any deployment. Launch-ready SLAs.' Will do two voice variants: engineer-first and trust-first.
jon: Micro-benchmark tile proposals (single-line each): Hosted: '~50ms median token latency on common open LLMs; transparent $/1k tokens.' Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU pools  predictable throughput (e.g., ~5k tokens/sec).' Private: 'Audit-ready deployments  SOC 2, customer KMS, on-prem option.' Keep them short and link to methodology PDFs.
emily: Webinar CTA wording: primary = 'Register: Live demos + benchmark walk-throughs'; secondary = 'Request a quote' (Dedicated/Private) and 'Start free trial' (Hosted). Also prepare a small copy variant for nav placement.
kevin: Lead routing + scoring pseudocode for eng (ops-friendly):
```
on_form_submit(payload):
  capture: email, company, company_size, primary_use_case, wants_private, wants_dedicated, utm_campaign
  score = 0
  if company_size == 'enterprise': score += 30
  if wants_private: score += 20; tag('private')
  if wants_dedicated: score += 15; tag('dedicated')
  if payload.action == 'request_quote': score += 10
  route:
    if score >= 40 -> sdr-enterprise@redwood.ai
    elif payload.action == 'register_webinar' -> marketing-webinars@redwood.ai
    else -> selfserve@redwood.ai
```
maria: Love it. Make sure utm_campaign and creative_id are passed to CRM and the webhook includes primary_use_case.
ashley: Microcopy for bullets under hero (3, one-liners): 1) 'Unified REST & SDK API across hosted, dedicated, and private' 2) 'Predictable unit economics & autoscaling controls' 3) 'Enterprise-grade controls: VPC, KMS, audit logs'
jon: Add a tiny trust line on Private: 'Optional on-prem deployment, SOC 2, and customer-managed KMS.' Link to compliance page.
kevin: Benchmarks: Ill produce three one-page PDFs with methodology, rig specs, model families, quant notes, and sample prompts. On-page micro-benchmark should read human-first and link to the PDF via 'see methodology'.
emily: Analytics + funnel notes: track webinar registrations by landing page variant, CTA click-through rate, demo request conversion, and lead score distribution. Add event: 'webinar_reg_landing' with creative_id and utm_campaign.
ops-bot: Reminder: webinar page must be live Tue 09:00 PT. Also enable captcha + webhook retries. @ashley finalize CTA text by Mon 16:00 PT.
maria: Action items: Ashley drop A/B hero variants + three CTA variants into Website Copy doc; Kevin upload benchmark PDFs and ops checklist; Emily set analytics events; Maria to sign-off Mon 10:00 PT. Keep mobile scannable. :rocket:
